summary: Fix pack 3 backend testing — 20/20 pytest tests passed on preview URL. Covered: GET /waitlist/grouped shape + admin/manager access + POST /waitlist/{wid}/notify; POST /public/out-of-catalog (no auth) + GET /out-of-catalog grouped-by-keyword with counts; GET /abandoned-carts/{aid} enriched (customer_stats {orders_count,total_spent,tier,loyalty_points}, customer_full, reminders) + 404; POST /abandoned-carts/relaunch with explicit cart_ids (template placeholders {prénom}/{produits}/{code}/{date_fin}/{lien_panier} + whatsapp_outbox + cart_reminders + status→relance) and with period_from/period_to; role-enforced PATCH /orders/{oid}/status-v3 (manager→livree 403, rider→nouvelle 403, admin→livree OK with reason, 404 for unknown oid, auto-invoice on livree); GET /orders/{oid}/invoice shape + POST /orders/{oid}/generate-invoice idempotent. Fix pack 1+2 regression (auth/me, products, audit-logs admin-only, roles) also green.

minor.issue: Admin override reason-requirement is unreachable code: ROLE_ALLOWED_STATUSES['admin']=None so `allowed is not None` is False — the whole override branch (403 + 400-missing-reason) never runs for admin. Admin can set `livree` without a reason. If the PRD requires admin to always provide a reason for terminal overrides, change ROLE_ALLOWED_STATUSES['admin'] to an explicit set or restructure the check. Current behaviour: admin can set any status, reason optional.

Invoice status computation at L3306 — `'payee' if o.get('payment_status') == 'paye' or True else 'a_payer'` — the `or True` short-circuits to always True, so invoice.status is always 'payee'. Likely a leftover debug; drop the `or True`.
Invoice number `INV-{int(time.time())%1000000}` is not collision-safe under concurrent deliveries (modulo 1e6 wraps every ~11 days). Consider a counter collection or UUID suffix.

Default behaviour when neither cart_ids nor period_* provided: targets ALL non-recovered abandoned carts (potentially large blast). Consider requiring at least one of {cart_ids, period_from+period_to} to prevent accidental mass-WhatsApp.
No rate limit / anti-spam on the public endpoint. Any client can flood db.out_of_catalog. Add IP throttle or capcha.

action_items: Remove `or True` in invoice-status ternary at server.py L3306 (status always resolves to 'payee').
Decide whether admin should be forced to provide a reason for terminal-status overrides; if yes, give admin an explicit allowed set in ROLE_ALLOWED_STATUSES so the override branch actually runs.
Make invoice number generation collision-safe (atomic counter or UUID).
Require at least cart_ids OR (period_from+period_to) for /abandoned-carts/relaunch to prevent accidental mass-send.
